Acute pancreatitis is a type of inflammatory condition that affects the pancreas, making B1 (Inflammatory Abdominal Conditions) the most taxonomically compatible parent.

Ectopic pregnancy is a type of pregnancy-related condition, making B4 (Pregnancy-Related Abdominal Conditions) the most taxonomically compatible parent.
Hepatic Vein Thrombosis is a type of vascular condition that affects the liver, making B3 (Vascular Abdominal Conditions) the most taxonomically compatible parent.
